apache-jmeter.about: Apache JMeter is an open source, 100% pure Java application designed to load test functional behavior and measure performance, originally focused on web applications but expanded to other test functions.
features: Supports various test types: Web (HTTP/HTTPS), FTP, JDBC, LDAP, Java, and JUnit
Thread Group management for load testing scenarios
Test plan construction, parameterization, and script recording capabilities
Listeners for data visualization and metrics collection
aiFeatures: JSR223 samplers with support for scripting languages like Groovy
Backend Listener for real-time results (e.g., InfluxDB, Graphite)
HTTP(S) Test Script Recorder for capturing test samples
Ability to parameterize tests and use variables across thread groups

latestRelease.notes: Included various bug fixes, such as resolving issues with summary report response times, NullPointerExceptions in timers, and restoring binary API compatibility. Also included non-functional improvements like Gradle updates and migration of certain tests to Kotlin and JUnit 5.

blazemeter.about: BlazeMeter is an enterprise continuous testing platform owned by Perforce that unifies performance, functional, and API testing with service virtualization and AI-powered test data. It is designed for DevOps teams to test at scale while maintaining compatibility with open-source tools.
features: 100% compatibility with open-source tools (e.g., JMeter, Selenium, Gatling, Playwright)
Cloud-based auto-scaling load infrastructure (up to millions of virtual users)
Hybrid deployment with support for private locations behind firewalls
Service virtualization to simulate environment dependencies
BlazeMeter Environment Manager for standardized JMeter bundles
Centralized audit logs for service virtualization
blazemeter.pricing: BlazeMeter offers various plans starting from $149/month for small teams, with options for larger organizations (e.g., $499/month, $649/month). Pricing is primarily based on credit types such as Variable Units (VU), Variable Unit Hours (VUH), or total tests, with enterprise custom plans and volume discounts available.
aiFeatures: Semantic API testing with AI assertion for response validation
Natural-language requests and filters for finding tests and executions via MCP Server

latestRelease.notes: Introduces searchable Service Virtualization Audit Logs for tracking workspace changes and API Monitoring enhancements including a semantic "is similar (AI)" assertion for dynamic content validation.

gatling.about: Gatling is a high-performance load testing platform designed for developers and teams, providing continuous performance intelligence and automated load testing capabilities throughout the software lifecycle.
features: Code-based test creation using SDKs for Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Scala, and Kotlin
Protocol-agnostic load engine with built-in HTTP and JMS support
Asynchronous, event-driven architecture for high-concurrency simulation with minimal resource usage
CI/CD integration for automated testing workflows
Distributed load injection on-demand across cloud or on-prem environments
Visual test builder and HTTP recorder for simplified test creation
Enterprise features including real-time dashboards, team collaboration, and automated infrastructure provisioning
gatling.pricing: Gatling offers a free Community Edition. Gatling Enterprise Edition pricing is available via tiered plans including Starter-pack options (e.g., €89/month billed annually) and custom tailormade solutions; contact sales for specific needs.
aiFeatures: AI-assisted test writing, explanation, and optimization in IDEs via VS Code extension
Gatling MCP Server and Skills for integrating with AI coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor
Automated performance insights and anomaly detection in Gatling Enterprise Edition

latestRelease.notes: Introduced Gatling MCP server update for integrating with AI coding agents.
